findings.category: terminology consistency / unrecorded per-sense term split
findings.problem: The revised value is faithful and idiomatic, but it is now the ONLY rendering of English 'Custom' in the whole ru catalogue set: «Произвольн…» occurs exactly once across src/i18n/catalogues/ru/*.json, while the established ru rendering of the same English label is the possessive adjective «Свои/Свой/Своё/Своя» in at least six places (ui.agents.pages.scope.custom «Свои» for en 'Custom', ui.settings.appearance.editor.custom_group «Свои темы», ui.canvas.insert_table_popover.custom_size «Свой размер», ui.chat.directory.menu.custom «Свой каталог», ui.common.models.model_select.custom_model «Своя модель», ui.settings.model.model_setting_options.custom_value «Своё значение»). The glossary binds a rendering per term («the SAME rendered word in every locale unless a row says otherwise») and has NO 'custom' row, so nothing authorises or forbids the split; the divergence is defensible on sense (a free-form taxonomy class that also holds agent-created and uncategorised tags, not an ownership scope), but it is a second vocabulary for one English headword that no recorded call covers, and a reader arriving from the Agents surface («Свои») will scan this rail for «Свои». The ru guide's own mechanism for exactly this is the recorded-call list («## Wave-2 recorded calls … every call below was audited in the catalogues before landing here», plus the recorded width/budget exceptions), and the translator's revision note ends «Proposal: none needed».
